annotations.text:
THE MARK, AND THE ONE FORK TAKEN
Outline plus segments, unchanged: idle the outline is the input · running it holds the sentence · blocked it is the whole page · review outline plus finished bar · ledger the bar alone.
The fork: a chart cannot have gaze. The companion keeps the primitives — capsule outline, clay fill — and stops being a chart. Everywhere else the mark still is one.

SEGMENTS
Clay at three tints, one per domain, ordered by time. Away is hatched, never a solid grey — a hatch says unmeasured rather than another site.
4px gaps do the separating, so the tints never have to carry contrast they cannot hold.
The rows below repeat the swatch, so the bar needs no inline labels.

MOTION
The review is the one authored moment: label, outline, plan, bar, then rows staggered 50ms, 280ms exponential ease-out.
The popup does not animate — it is opened dozens of times a day.
The block page settles once from 8px with a 3px blur, 240ms.
The companion breathes and blinks and does nothing else. Budget: three noticeable movements per 25 minutes, none in the first 60 seconds. Arousal is the risk, not attention.

ONE DOC CONFLICT, NOT RESOLVED HERE
design-toolkit §9 says the block page has NO countdown. build.md TASK-007 says it shows the intention AND remaining time, and the shipped blocked.js prints minutes.
Drawn here as a static line, not a ticking clock — the least-wrong reading of both. Worth an explicit call before it ships.

LANDING — Persuade, 1440 desktop
1440 viewport with a 1200 content column, the reference's own max width. Header bar, then the fold: mark, headline, one action.
The four beats use the mark evolving across the loop rather than four matching cards.
Hero mark draws once on load, 900ms — the single authored moment here.

THE COMPANION — gaze, not a face
Aliveness is breathing and a rare blink. State is gaze and posture, never an action.
Settled: the aperture sits low, aligned with where the bar sits everywhere else — it is looking at the work, alongside you. Facing your work is a POSTURE, not an event, which is how there is a positive state with no reward in it.
Drifting: the aperture rises, opens, and the stroke thickens. One move. No sound, no words, no colour change.
It never varies with the outcome answer. Yes and Not yet leave it identical — otherwise it becomes a reason to lie.
Nothing good ever happens here on screen. The return, the finished step, the honest answer: all of it waits for the review.

PRIVACY BEAT, REWRITTEN
“It stores hostnames. Never a page, never a title” was true of v0.1 and is false now — the judge reads the tab.
The replacement is narrower in what it permits and stronger in what it guarantees: read once, keep the site name and one verdict word, no column, no log, no queue.
A marketing page that outlives its own architecture is the fastest way to lose the one audience that came for the privacy.
